The '''Duel on Vohai''' took place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] between [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Sa Cuis]], sent by his master [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to kill Vader. However, the duel was in fact a test for Vader, Palpatine's true [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]. Vader confronted Cuis in the courtyard of [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] after killing several [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] sent by Cuis. Though Cuis put up a furious fight, he was defeated by Vader.
